attachments.title: HyMEx 2021 – Hybrid Museum Experience Symposium | Online Symposium | May 6-7, 2021
attachments.text: During Spring 2021, HyMEx // Hybrid Museum Experience Symposium // aims to bring together leading researchers, scholars in digital and experimental museology, in collection care, curatorial practice, as well as researchers from a broad spectrum of disciplines to exchange views on challenging situations and latest innovations in the field of hybrid museum experiences, with a focus on contemporary art. The two-day symposium organised by Ludwig Museum on May 6-7, 2021 in Budapest takes place as a following stage of the path introduced by the media preservation symposium MAPS in 2015, followed by three editions.
